_help: Logos of the member organisations registered for an upcoming event, in the right-hand column of its page. Registrations are matched to members by exact email domain; cancellations and no-shows do not count. Non-member organisations are only counted. 'min_members': the block shows from this many member organisations. 'max_logos': logos shown before 'and N more'. 'exclude': member names or email domains never to show.
heading: Member organisations attending
